handler.description: Request the received-to-in-testing transition for the subject sample.
Request the ready-to-in-progress transition for the subject test.
Create a related recorded result from value/unit input and subject test/sample references, then complete the subject test. Atomic execution is reserved for P3.

Compare the subject result to the related test specification using its measurement. The fictional pH range is phMinimum/phMaximum; conductivity uses conductivityMinimum/conductivityMaximum. Populate assessment as below-range, within-range or above-range, assess the result, and create an open exception only for a failing assessment. P3 will implement the Pack-owned handler.
Create a pending review linked to the subject sample, then request awaiting-QA state.
Request in-review state for the subject exception.
Stage the supplied disposition, require it to be nonempty in proposed state, then request resolved state.
Stage the supplied rationale, validate proposed rationale and current related sample evidence, then request approved review state.
Stage the supplied rationale, require nonempty rationale in proposed state, then request returned review state.
Require completed tests, resolved exceptions and approved linked reviews, then request approved sample state.

facts.statement: The demo provides a manually navigable sample-to-QA walkthrough with fixed synthetic data.
SMP-1001 has a prefilled pH result of 6.4 against the fictional 6.8–7.2 range and EXC-1001 remains unresolved.
Analyst, QA, and Lab Manager roles and action permissions are defined in the Pack; enforcement is reserved for the deterministic engine.
Synthetic approval rules require completed tests and resolved exceptions; P2 does not execute approval.
Acme is fictional. This Pack provides no evidence of a real vendor capability, regulatory compliance or enterprise readiness.

approvedQA.question: What can I explore today?
approvedQA.answer: Four fictional demo paths through a fixed sample-to-QA story. Navigation is available; execution and approval remain definitions only.

approvedQA.question: Why does this sample have an exception?
approvedQA.answer: Its prefilled pH value is 6.4, below the fictional 6.8–7.2 range. The fixture does not establish a root cause.

approvedQA.question: Does this represent a real vendor or establish compliance?
approvedQA.answer: No. Acme is fictional, and this Pack makes no real vendor, compliance or enterprise-readiness claim.
